senses.gloss: ch. <cite ref="D01129">same</cite>. [<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 48:26">Targ. Jer. XLVIII, 26</cite>, some ed., <he>ידרשון</he>, v. <cite ref="D01153"><he>דְּשַׁשׁ</he></cite>.] <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 5:9">Targ. Jud. V, 9</cite>.—
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 51b:13">Succ. 51ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>קרא אשכחו ודָרוּשׁ</he> they found a Bible verse and interpreted it.
<cite ref="Arakhin 30b:3">Arakh. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>איכא למִידְרְשִׁינְהוּ וכ׳</he> it may be interpreted in favor of a lenient practice &c.—
<cite ref="Sotah 21a:14">Sot. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּרְשַׁיה</he> … <he>להאי קרא</he> R. … interpreted this verse.
<cite ref="Sotah 21a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>מאי דָרוּשׁ</he> what verse did they interpret (to guide them in their action)?—
<cite ref="Beitzah 28a:19">Bets. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>דַּרְשִׁינָן משמך</he> we taught in thy name.
<cite ref="Yevamot 94a:10">Yeb. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה ליה</he> … <he>למִידְרַשׁ וכ׳</he> R. El. might have given a valuable interpretation &c., v. <cite ref="M02526"><he>מַרְגְּנִיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9:9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite> <he>עד דיחסל מִמִּדְרַשׁ</he> until he ended his lecture.
Ber. 28ᵃ נִדְרוֹשׁ מר וכ׳ shall this teacher lecture one Sabbath, and the other &c.? Ib. לִדְרוֹשׁ ר׳ (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note); a. v. fr.—דָּרֵישׁ lecturer.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:6:6">Y. Yeb. XII, 13ᵃ</cite> top <he>ד׳ ודיין וכ׳</he> to serve as lecturer, judge &c.

<cite ref="Berakhot 63a:8">Ber. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>האי קרא … מִדְּרִישׁ וכ׳</he> this verse (<cite ref="Psalms 119:126">Ps. CXIX, 126</cite>) can be interpreted in its regular order (it is time to work &c., because people neglect the law) or in inverted order (the teachers ignore the letter of the law, because it is time to work for the Lord by guarding its spirit); ib. 60ᵃ; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 70a:17">Snh. 70ᵃ</cite>
